exposure: perineal wound complications in first birth
perineal wound complications and obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI) in first birth
outcome: Obstetric Anal Sphincter Injury (OASI) in second birth
cohort: Women (n = 411,317) who had first and second singleton vaginal births in Sweden between 2001 and 2019.
finding: Perineal wound complications in the first birth significantly increase the odds of OASI in a subsequent vaginal birth, with the risk being substantially higher if OASI was also present in the first birth.
